topic.title: Debugging Exercises
topic.description: A collection of buggy programs covering off-by-one errors, type mismatches, indentation errors, and logical mistakes — each paired with a corrected version.

learningNotes.whatILearned: How to identify syntax errors (caught by interpreter immediately), runtime errors (crash during execution), and logical errors (wrong output silently). Using print statements to trace flow.
learningNotes.challenges: Logical errors are hardest to find because the program runs without crashing.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Learn Python logging module and try using pdb (Python debugger).
